ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area comprising approximately 75% of the visible fluke, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters comprising the remaining 25% concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity black zone centered on the fluke body. High-intensity white contiguous blobs are located at the lateral distal margins (tips) of both lobes, featuring irregular, streaked interior borders where they meet the black central mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge. Visible pixel-amplitude variations indicate a jagged boundary with multiple localized peaks and valleys occurring every 20-40 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep trajectory on the superior edge of the left lobe; right lobe sweep is partially occluded by water splash but follows a symmetric convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel formations (barnacles) visible at the extreme outer edges of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) distributed across the dark central and right-central fluke surface, intersecting the natural pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the dorsal/ventral surface and significant barnacle encrustation on the lateral tips.
